sentences.text: Crr 2806 of 2024 Sushil Sarkar Vs. The State of West Bengal & Anr.
Learned advocate for the petitioner is present.
Heard the learned advocate for the petitioner.

Learned advocate for the petitioner submits that the case was initially started under Section 498A I.P.C. and after a considerable period of 12 years of trial, learned Magistrate before whom the trial was held observed that offence under Section 302 is also existing and thereafter was pleased to comm9it the case to the Court of Sessions.
The petitioner being aggrieved by the said order has come up with the instant application.
Upon hearing the learned advocate for the petitioner and considering the facts of this case, this Court is of the view that this application should be admitted.
Thus, I admit this revisional application.
Let notice be issued upon the opposite parties and affidavit of service be filed on the reopening date after the vacation.
Let the matter appear three weeks after the annual vacation under the heading "Contested Application".
As this matter is subjudice before this Court, petitioner is granted liberty to pray for adjournment before the learned court below which may be considered.

(Biswaroop Chowdhury, J.)
